tasks.title: Foundation: extend authentication (Session columns, LoginRequest fields, SessionRepository ABC + SqliteSessionRepository), create the sessionmanagement package (events, SessionEntry), and implement SessionService with constructor DI + list_sessions
tasks.red_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/sessionmanagement/ tests/property/sessionmanagement/ tests/unit/sessionmanagement/ tests/contract/sessionmanagement/ tests/integration/sessionmanagement/ -v
implementation_steps: Extend authentication's Session table (src/backend/authentication/models.py): add nullable columns user_agent, ip, device_name, login_method (all default None) to the Session SQLModel; existing rows remain NULL (REQ-016, ADR-062)
Extend authentication's LoginRequest (src/backend/authentication/models.py): add optional user_agent, ip, device_name fields (all default None) (REQ-016, ADR-062)

Extend authentication's SessionRepository ABC (src/backend/authentication/repositories.py): add abstract methods get(session_id) -> Session | None, list_for_user(user_id) -> Sequence[Session], revoke_user_sessions(user_id, exclude_session_id=None) -> int; extend delete_expired(limit=None) -> int (optional limit, None = all, the previous behavior); all existing ABC methods retain their behavior (REQ-017, ADR-061)

Implement the new ABC methods in SqliteSessionRepository (src/backend/authentication/repository.py): get (row by id, any revocation state), list_for_user (ALL rows for the user, any revocation state, created_at descending), revoke_user_sessions (revoke all for the user except the excluded, return the count), delete_expired(limit) (delete up to limit expired rows, return the count) (REQ-017, ADR-061)

Create src/backend/sessionmanagement/__init__.py (public API), events.py (SessionRevoked, AllSessionsRevoked, ExpiredSessionsDeleted, SessionsListed — frozen Pydantic models, non-sensitive data only: user ids, session ids, counts — never raw tokens or token hashes), and models.py (SessionEntry frozen Pydantic model: session_id, created_at, expires_at, is_current, user_agent, ip, device_name, login_method) (REQ-018, REQ-004, NFR-002)

Create src/backend/sessionmanagement/service.py with SessionService(repository, event_bus=None, settings_registry=None): constructor DI (REQ-020, ADR-065); a None event_bus means no events and no subscriptions; a None settings_registry uses the shared get_settings_registry() (REQ-020)

Implement list_sessions(token=None, user_id=None, limit=None) -> list[SessionEntry]: exactly one of token/user_id (both or neither -> ValueError) (REQ-001, EDGE-008); the token path resolves the user and the current session via authentication's session_info(token), re-raising InvalidSessionError for unknown/revoked/expired (REQ-002); the list contains only valid sessions (unrevoked and unexpired) (REQ-003, INV-002); each entry exposes the device fields (None for pre-feature rows) (REQ-004, EDGE-006); is_current True for exactly the token's session (token path), all False on the admin (user_id) path (REQ-005); ordering created_at descending with the current session (token path) pinned first (REQ-006, INV-005, ADR-066); bounded by limit with no offset (default the live-read sessionmanagement.max_listed_sessions, limit < 1 -> ValueError, truncate to limit) (REQ-007, EDGE-009, ADR-066); publish SessionsListed(user_id, count) (REQ-018, AC-037, ADR-068)
Add a _read_setting(registry, key, fallback) live-read helper (an unregistered key returns the fallback) for the live settings reads (REQ-019)
Export the public API from __init__.py (SessionService, SessionEntry, the 4 events)
tasks.green_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/sessionmanagement/ tests/property/sessionmanagement/ tests/unit/sessionmanagement/ tests/contract/sessionmanagement/ tests/integration/sessionmanagement/ -v
design_constraints: Reuse authentication's Session table + SessionRepository (constructor-injected); no second session store (REQ-017, ADR-061)

The ABC extension is additive and backward-compatible per authentication NFR-003: all existing ABC methods retain their behavior; only delete_expired gains a backward-compatible optional limit (REQ-017, ADR-061)
The list contains only valid sessions (unrevoked and unexpired) — authentication INV-002 (REQ-003, INV-002)
Ordering created_at descending with the current session (token path) pinned first (REQ-006, INV-005, ADR-066)
Bounded by limit with no offset; limit < 1 -> ValueError (REQ-007, ADR-066)
A None event_bus means no events and no subscriptions (REQ-018, REQ-020, ADR-065)
Raw session tokens and token hashes never appear in list entries (only session ids) (REQ-021, NFR-002)
No new exception types: argument errors are ValueError; invalid-token failures re-raise authentication's InvalidSessionError (REQ-002, ADR-067)
completion_gates: Acceptance tests for AC-001, AC-002, AC-004, AC-005, AC-006, AC-007, AC-009, AC-010, AC-011, AC-012, AC-033, AC-037 pass
Unit tests for AC-003, AC-013, EDGE-008, EDGE-009 pass
Acceptance tests for EDGE-006, EDGE-007 pass
Property tests for INV-002, INV-005 pass

tasks.title: Revocation operations: revoke_session, logout_all_sessions, logout_other_sessions, revoke_all_sessions
tasks.red_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/sessionmanagement/ tests/property/sessionmanagement/ tests/unit/sessionmanagement/ tests/contract/sessionmanagement/ tests/integration/sessionmanagement/ -v
implementation_steps: Implement revoke_session(session_id) -> None on SessionService: revoke the session with that id via the repository; an unknown or already-revoked id is an idempotent no-op (no error, no event); publish SessionRevoked(user_id, session_id) when a session is revoked (REQ-008, REQ-018, ADR-067, ADR-068)

Implement logout_all_sessions(token) -> None on SessionService: resolve the token via session_info (re-raise InvalidSessionError for unknown/revoked/expired); revoke all sessions for the user including the caller's own session; publish AllSessionsRevoked(user_id, excluded_session_id=None) (REQ-009, REQ-018, ADR-068)

Implement logout_other_sessions(token) -> None on SessionService: resolve the token via session_info (re-raise InvalidSessionError for unknown/revoked/expired); revoke all sessions for the user except the caller's current session; publish AllSessionsRevoked(user_id, excluded_session_id=<caller's session id>) (REQ-010, REQ-018, ADR-068)

Implement revoke_all_sessions(user_id, exclude_session_id=None) -> int on SessionService (admin; open in-process, no token): revoke all sessions for the user except the excluded session via the repository's revoke_user_sessions; return the count; publish AllSessionsRevoked(user_id, excluded_session_id) when the count > 0 (REQ-011, REQ-018, ADR-068)
An operation that revokes 0 sessions publishes no event (AC-035, ADR-068)
Update the public API export in __init__.py if needed
tasks.green_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/sessionmanagement/ tests/property/sessionmanagement/ tests/unit/sessionmanagement/ tests/contract/sessionmanagement/ tests/integration/sessionmanagement/ -v
design_constraints: revoke_session is an idempotent no-op for unknown/already-revoked ids — no error, no event (REQ-008, ADR-067)
No new exception types: invalid-token failures re-raise authentication's InvalidSessionError (REQ-009, REQ-010, ADR-067)
Revocation is idempotent for re-runs — no error, no state change, no duplicate event (INV-001, ADR-067)
Events carry non-sensitive data only — user ids, session ids; never raw tokens or token hashes (REQ-018, NFR-002, ADR-068)
An operation that revokes 0 sessions publishes no event (AC-035, ADR-068)
logout_all_sessions revokes the caller's own session (self-lockout accepted for self-service) (EDGE-004)
completion_gates: Acceptance tests for AC-014, AC-015, AC-016, AC-017, AC-018, AC-019, AC-020, AC-021, AC-022, AC-023 pass
Acceptance tests for EDGE-001, EDGE-002, EDGE-003, EDGE-004, EDGE-005 pass

tasks.title: Per-user session cap: event-driven eviction on LoginSucceeded (oldest first)
tasks.red_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/sessionmanagement/ tests/property/sessionmanagement/ tests/unit/sessionmanagement/ tests/contract/sessionmanagement/ tests/integration/sessionmanagement/ -v
implementation_steps: Subscribe the service to authentication's LoginSucceeded event (when the event_bus is not None): register a handler in SessionService.__init__ (REQ-014, ADR-063)

Implement the cap-eviction handler: on LoginSucceeded, if the user's valid session count exceeds the live-read sessionmanagement.max_sessions_per_user, revoke the oldest valid sessions (created_at ascending) until the count equals the cap; the newly issued session is always kept (REQ-014, ADR-063)
The cap is live-read on each login (REQ-019), so a registry change takes effect at the next login
Eviction is idempotent for re-runs (INV-001, ADR-063)
tasks.green_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/sessionmanagement/ tests/property/sessionmanagement/ tests/unit/sessionmanagement/ tests/contract/sessionmanagement/ tests/integration/sessionmanagement/ -v
design_constraints: The cap is enforced event-driven on LoginSucceeded — authentication's login path is not modified beyond the additive login schema fields (REQ-014, ADR-063)
After LoginSucceeded handling, the user's valid session count is at most the cap (INV-003)
The oldest valid sessions (created_at ascending) are revoked; the new session is kept (REQ-014, ADR-063)
The cap is live-read (REQ-019), so a registry change takes effect at the next login
Eviction is idempotent for re-runs — no error, no state change, no duplicate event (INV-001, ADR-063)

Acceptance test for EDGE-011 passes
Property test for INV-003 passes
